Carezaar LLC (“Carezaar,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) operates a technology platform that uses artificial intelligence (AI) and information provided by users to help connect individuals seeking care (“Care Needers”) with individuals offering care services (“Caregivers”). Carezaar acts solely as a platform to facilitate connections between users. Carezaar does not itself provide, perform, arrange, or supervise caregiving, personal care, home care, nursing, medical, or other healthcare services. Carezaar is not a healthcare provider, medical practice, home care agency, home health agency, nursing registry, employer, or staffing agency solely by virtue of operating the Platform. The Platform allows Care Needers and Caregivers to create profiles, discover potential matches, review information, and communicate through available features. Users are solely responsible for independently evaluating one another and deciding whether to enter into any arrangement. Carezaar does not guarantee that a match will be available, suitable, or successful.

Users must independently evaluate potential matches and should not rely solely on AI-generated results when making decisions about care.
